artworks.title: The Great Villa of the Quintilii on the Appian Way
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an ancient, partially ruined brick structure standing on a grassy mound. The horizon is low in the composition, revealing fields and hills in the distance. There are hints of a cityscape far away, possibly showing an aqueduct or arches. The painting is done using watercolor with soft brushstrokes blending earthy greens, browns, and pale blue sky. The ruins are depicted in textured brick red. The sky is painted in light blue and white with fluffy clouds. The color palette is warm and muted, with gentle contrasts between the natural landscape and the architecture.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child with Saints
artworks.medium: pen and iron gall ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people in various poses and interactions. The drawing features loosely sketched figures that appear to be gathered together, with some standing and others seated. The use of black ink on paper creates a dynamic arrangement of lines that gives a sense of movement and interaction among the figures. Several figures are marked with inscriptions, suggesting they might represent specific characters or ideas, though these inscriptions are not legible enough for interpretation. The details are minimal, focusing on the form and posture of the figures more than detailed features. The overall composition is quite sketch-like and possibly serves as a preliminary study for a more detailed work, focusing on capturing the essence and relationship between the figures.

artworks.title: Two Nude Men
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray-brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two male figures, one standing and one seated, in a dynamic pose. The standing figure is in a forward-leaning position, with his left leg stepping down onto a stone-like surface while supporting himself with his bent right leg. He is holding the limp seated figure by the upper arm and shoulder. The seated figure appears slumped, with his head leaning back against the standing figure's thigh and his right hand gripping his knee. The standing male has short, curly hair and a muscular build, with striking facial features. The background consists of neutral tones, emphasizing the figures. There are no visible accessories. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic style with dark brown lines and shadings.

artworks.title: The Women at the Sepulchre with Christ of the Noli me Tangere
artworks.medium: red chalk with red wash, heightened with white gouache on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features five figures in various poses, with one central figure elevated above the others. The figures are depicted from the waist up to the upper body, with varying hairstyles and clothing styles. The central figure appears to be in motion with outstretched arms, while the others are standing or kneeling around them. The drawing is done in a classical style with no visible jewelry or objects held by the figures. The background is nondescript, allowing the focus to be on the figures.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.medium: black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of a person's face and the top of their shoulders. The person is facing the viewer with their head slightly turned to the right. Their facial features include expressive eyes with arched eyebrows and a focused gaze. The individual has a slender mustache and short, wavy hair parted softly on the side. They are not wearing any clothing, jewelry, or visible attire in this cropped portrait. The background is a plain, textured paper.

artworks.title: "Barrington bore it all with exemplary patience"
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with graphite on heavy wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 22 x 30.2 cm (8 11/16 x 11 7/8 in.)
image (6.4 cm of sheet width is folded under): 22 x 23.8 cm (8 11/16 x 9 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals seated indoors. The man in the center is holding a hat, the woman on the left has a fan, and the woman on the right has a bouquet of flowers or decorative items on the table next to her. The setting includes ornate chairs and a detailed interior background.

artworks.title: A Letter from Iris Court with Sketches of Henry Irving
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper [Iris Court letterhead]
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch on light-colored paper, showing two views of a man's head and shoulders. The main focus is on a profile view of the man's head and upper torso, facing to the right. The sketch captures his features with a mix of detailed and shaded lines, emphasizing the hair and facial features such as the nose and brow. His hair appears to be long and wavy, extending to the neck area. The man seems to wear a collared garment, visible through sketch lines around the neck. Beneath the profile, there is a smaller frontal sketch of the man, capturing a mild expression with less detail, focusing on the structure of eyes, nose, and lips. The background of the page features header text "IRIS COURT PANGBOURNE BERKSHIRE" on the top left and "TELEPHONE: 94 PANGBOURNE" on the top right, with a handwritten note and monogram near the sketches.

artworks.title: A Letter From Iris Court with a Portrait of John L. Toole
artworks.medium: graphite with watercolor on wove paper [Iris Court letterhead]
artworks.description: The image displays a sketch on a piece of stationery depicting the upper part of a person's body. The person's head and shoulders are depicted, facing slightly to the right. Their facial features are delicately drawn with a gentle expression. The hair is loosely styled and voluminous. The person is wearing a jacket and shirt. The background is plain, with text and a letterhead stating "IRIS COURT PANGBOURNE BERKSHIRE" on the top left and "TELEPHONE, 94 PANGBOURNE." on the top right. Below the letterhead, there is a handwritten note in cursive with an emblem or monogram "KJ" in a small red box. The text continues onto the page, ending with the signature "Mortimer Menpes." The page has a yellowed tone.

artworks.title: A Male Nude Moving to the Left
artworks.medium: black chalk, heightened with white chalk on olive-green wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a male figure in a dynamic pose, holding an elongated object. The figure has distinct facial features and short hair, and is depicted without clothing to highlight muscle detail. The background consists of textured lines indicating depth and movement, with no additional elements present.

artworks.title: Landscape with Ancient Tombs
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on tan laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees and architectural structures viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The scene includes trees, clouds, and classical ruins with detailed carvings. The artist uses a sketch-like style with fine lines and watercolor-like washes of brown and gray tones. The color palette consists of warm browns and cool grays, creating a serene atmosphere. Large trees with dark canopies frame the right side of the composition.

artworks.title: A Standing Saint Holding a Book and a Palm Frond
artworks.medium: black chalk, heightened with white chalk on tan laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body drawing of a person standing straight with one hand at chest level and the other by their side. The person has indistinct facial features and a neutral expression, short wavy or curly hair, and wears a loose, long robe with full sleeves, detailed with a pattern or design along the edges, and a textured, heavy fabric appearance. The background is plain and lightly shaded.

artworks.title: The Colosseum
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray and gray-brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the Colosseum from a lower vantage point, showcasing its architectural grandeur with detailed brushstrokes emphasizing its structure. The color palette is limited to sepia and grey tones, creating a historical ambiance. Figures are seen in the foreground, with ruins of the Colosseum extending into the distance. The sky is mostly clear with a few faint clouds.

artworks.title: A Male Nude Kneeling
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a male figure in a dynamic pose. His body is visible, shown in a kneeling position with one leg raised. His head is slightly tilted downward, with one arm above his head and the other lowered. The figure has curly hair, minimal facial features, and is not wearing any clothing. The sketch uses lines and hatching to depict the muscular form, with no background details present.

artworks.title: Two Ancient Warriors Fighting over a Dead Comrade
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two warriors preparing to strike each other with weapons. The image depicts two muscular figures, one on each side of a central, kneeling figure. Both warriors are in dynamic poses, one wielding a sword raised high and the other holding a long spear. They are both adorned with helmets, with plumed designs, and are minimally clothed. The central figure appears to be in distress, kneeling with arms outstretched. Below them lies an abandoned helmet. The drawing is sketched with fine lines, capturing the intensity and movement of the scene.

artworks.title: A Standing Male Nude
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a full-body male figure in a dynamic pose with the upper body turned to the left. The facial features are idealized with a focused expression, and the hair is in loose curls. The figure appears unclothed against a plain background, framed by a beige border. Text below the sketch identifies the artist as Raffaello Sanzio, with the years 1483-1520 displayed. No visible jewelry or objects are present.

artworks.title: Chronos
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white gouache, on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of a seated figure. The person is reclining back against an object, and is turned slightly to one side. The figure has long hair, a beard, and is dressed in minimal clothing. The person is holding an object in one hand. The background is solid blue with a subtle texture, and a border frames the image.

artworks.title: Interior of the Church of San Benedetto, Subiaco
artworks.medium: brown wash and watercolor over graphite, with scratching out on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of an ornate chapel interior. It depicts an intricately designed chapel with detailed frescoes on its walls and ceiling. The vaulted ceiling features a fresco showing figures in soft pastel colors of blues and earthy tones. The architectural details such as arches and columns play with light and shadow, creating depth. In the center, there is an altar under a golden chandelier. The floor has geometric patterns leading towards the altar, framed by arches and religious iconography. The scene conveys a sense of tranquility and reverence.

artworks.title: A Landscape with Three Figures and a Dog
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray ways graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is located towards the upper third of the image, with a gently sloping hill extending from the center to the right. The brushstrokes are textured and fluid, depicting foliage and landscape contours with sketch-like precision. In the foreground, there are a small group of figures, including a woman, child, individual, and a small animal. A tree line with a dense canopy of leaves extends from the left towards the middle of the composition. The color palette consists of soft, muted browns and grays, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: A Soldier's Widow
artworks.medium: watercolor with pen and brown and gray ink over sanguine wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the chest upwards with a large hat and light-colored, shaggy hair. He has a broad face, a large nose, full lips, and wide eyes. The man wears a red coat over a yellowish scarf and is accompanied by what appears to be a broken pipe on his hat. The background is neutral with washes of beige and light brown.

artworks.title: Drovers with a Pair of Rearing Horses
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two men interacting with a pair of horses. On the left side, one man is seen in profile facing the horses with his mouth open. He has a round face with a prominent nose and is wearing a cap. His hand is raised towards the horses. On the right, another man is seated atop a horse, facing forward with a determined expression and holding a whip in his raised hand. The horses' heads are in front of the men, with open mouths and attentive eyes. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Fall of Phaeton
artworks.medium: pen and brown and gray ink with gray wash over graphite, corrected in white gouache, on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a mythological scene with a figure and a horse. The drawing depicts a muscular figure falling or reclining backwards with a downward gaze. He holds a sword in one hand, while the other seems to be tangled with reins or ropes that are connected to a horse. The horse appears to be rearing or falling, its limbs depicted in motion. The scene is shrouded in clouds and smoke-like forms. The use of lines and shading techniques highlights the figures' anatomy and creates a sense of movement.

artworks.title: Pope Alexander VII
artworks.medium: black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a circular drawing of a man's upper body in profile, facing left. The man has a distinct facial profile with a prominent nose, mustache, and goatee. His dark hair is combed back, and he is wearing a high-collared garment. The background is light and textured, enclosed within a circular frame on a green square border. No jewelry or objects are visible in the man's hands.

artworks.title: Saint Andrew
artworks.medium: red chalk with red and brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a full-body depiction of a figure standing and turned slightly to the side. His head is angled upwards, showcasing his facial features including a beard and wavy, shoulder-length hair. The figure is draped in loose garments, revealing one bare foot. He is shown holding an object resembling a tablet or book. The background is a textured shading. The drawing style suggests a classical theme, with sepia tones giving an aged artistic impression.

artworks.title: A Nude Man Chained to a Rock
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a nude male figure depicted from head to knee, reclining on his back with a dynamic pose. His left arm is bent over his head and his right arm extended upward. The facial features are delicately drawn, focusing on the outline of his face and a short hairstyle. There is subtle shading to suggest musculature and body contours. The sketch has a minimal style with emphasis on the figure's outline and form. The background is plain with sparse, loose lines, and the figure is set against a textured paper backdrop. No jewelry or objects are visible.
